description: This Rust source file defines structures and functions related to Content Security Policy (CSP) headers, including templates with nonce placeholders, applying CSP headers to HTTP responses, and associated tests.

classes.name: ContentSecurityPolicy
classes.description: Represents a CSP with a nonce value, used to generate and apply CSP headers.

classes.name: ContentSecurityPolicyTemplate
classes.description: A template for CSP headers containing a nonce placeholder, with methods to check if enabled and to format the nonce into the template.

methods.name: is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the CSP template has a nonce placeholder, indicating if CSP is enabled.

methods.name: format_nonce
methods.description: Replaces the nonce placeholder in the template with the actual nonce value.

methods.name: default
methods.description: Provides a default CSP template based on the DEFAULT_CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY constant.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a CSP template from a string, identifying the position of the nonce placeholder.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a CSP template from a string, used in JSON deserialization.

methods.name: with_random_nonce
methods.description: Creates a new CSP with a randomly generated nonce.

methods.name: apply_to_response
methods.description: Applies the CSP header with the formatted nonce to an HTTP response if enabled.
